description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of responses categorized as “W/ Demos”, “Hard to Tell”, and “W/o Demos”, alongside “Funny Reddit” and “Unhealthy Comments”. The chart consists of three separate pie charts, each with four slices. The first pie chart displays “W/o Demos” in light gray, representing 43.0% of the total, “Hard to Tell” in blue at 34.1%, and “W/ Demos” in light green at 22.9%. The second pie chart shows “Funny Reddit” in dark gray at 41.5%, and three slices of light green representing 37.1%, 21.5%. The third pie chart displays light green at 37.8%, light gray at 34.8%, dark gray at 27.4%, and a final slice at 0%. Each slice within the charts is labeled with its corresponding category and percentage value. There is a legend present indicating the color associated with each category. The slices do not appear to be ordered in any particular way.
